artifact_role.authority: 定义 Windows backend 如何消费 portable WebView contract
artifact_role.not_authority: 不定义 Runtime 安装器、企业部署策略或跨平台原生 API 完全相同

desired_effects.statement: Windows ARM64 Qt host can create a WebView2 session and page through the public interfaces.
Navigation, bridge, popup, download and resource mapping behavior follows the same observable public contract as macOS where WebView2 supports it.
Unsupported Runtime capabilities, including host-owned FileSelection, are explicit rather than silently emulated.

reader_questions.question: Windows ARM64 构建和 WebView2 Runtime 初始化是否已经可以通过公共 session 接口稳定创建页面？
reader_questions.why_it_matters: 没有可重复的 environment/controller 初始化，其他 backend 契约无法落地。
reader_questions.scope: vcpkg target, COM STA, environment, profile and controller lifecycle

reader_questions.question: Windows 页面承载、navigation、bridge、popup 和异步 completion 是否遵守公共生命周期与 host-owned 语义？
reader_questions.why_it_matters: 这些路径最容易把 COM callback、Qt UI 线程和 child ownership 混在一起。
reader_questions.scope: Qt HWND hosting, navigation, bridge, popup, completion guards and close

reader_questions.question: app:// resource mapping 和 download 是否提供真实内容/目标结果，并拒绝越界访问和过期 completion？
reader_questions.why_it_matters: 静态 resolver 检查不能证明 WebView2 生产请求和异步下载真的走通。
reader_questions.scope: custom scheme, WebResourceRequested, download deferral and mapping security

reader_questions.question: 能力差异和 FileSelection Unsupported 是否被明确报告，同时仍保持编译期 backend 选择？
reader_questions.why_it_matters: Windows 不能用未实现的 chooser shim 或动态 fallback 掩盖 SDK 限制。
reader_questions.scope: capabilitySupport, TODO marker, public boundary and CMake selection

decisive_result.question: Windows WebView2 backend 是否已按 portable contract 提供可运行、可验证且不自行猜测 host 行为的实现？
decisive_result.success_condition: ARM64 build and Runtime initialize; production page, navigation, bridge, popup, download and mapped resources work; unsupported FileSelection and Runtime gaps are explicit; public boundary remains native-type-free and static-selected.
decisive_result.failure_condition: Environment/controller lifecycle fails silently, callbacks enter COM from the wrong thread, ownership conflicts, resources are rewritten or unsafe, or unsupported chooser behavior is disguised as supported.

blocked_claims.claim: WebView2 Runtime 已随 vcpkg SDK 一起安装、发布或自动部署。
blocked_claims.reason: vcpkg package supplies SDK/loader, while Runtime deployment is explicitly outside this mission.
blocked_claims.release_condition: 另行批准并执行 Runtime deployment mission。

blocked_claims.claim: Windows FileSelection 已实现 host-owned HTML file chooser。
blocked_claims.reason: SDK 1.0.3800.47 lacks a public chooser interception event; this mission explicitly reports Unsupported and leaves a TODO marker.
blocked_claims.release_condition: WebView2 exposes a supported chooser event and a separate approved mission implements and tests it.
